text_md: Trial TDF2 Daily oral TDF/ FTC Botswana FEM-PrEP Study Population Serodiscordant couples may be a distinct, unique population. 67% protection with TDF alone; 75% protection with TDF/FTC No study drug significantly reduced the risk of HIV acquisition. Estimates of effectiveness were less than 0 for TDF and TDF/ FTC daily oral dosing (negative 48.8% and negative 4.2% TDF/FTC respectively), and reduced risk of HIV infection of 14.7% for TDF gel.
